small_guidance:
- The scatter kernel uses atomic_add into a zero-initialized output with grid (N, IC, ID)=64·3·32=6144 programs each doing IH·IW·KD·KH·KW=864 atomics of width BLOCK_OC=16 — atomics on global memory dominate. At minimum, swap the loop nest so each program owns an output tile (no atomics): parallelize over (N, OC_tile, OD_tile) and gather from input.
- Add `@triton.autotune` over (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SPATIAL) ∈ {(16,64),(32,64),(16,128),(32,128)} with num_warps∈{4,8}, num_stages=2; ensure (BM·BK+BK·BN)·4·stages ≤ 132KB.
- Fuse bias-add + BN affine + both avg_pool3d(2) stages (=avg_pool 4) directly into the conv-transpose epilogue so conv_out never has to be written/reread.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite ConvTranspose3d as a **gather-style GEMM** rather than scatter-add. For each output element (n, oc, od, oh, ow), iterate over (ic, kd, kh, kw); compute the corresponding input (id, ih, iw) = ((od+PD-kd)/SD, ...) with stride-divisibility and bounds masks; accumulate in registers. This eliminates all atomics and lets you tile the GEMM as M=OC, N=output-spatial-tile, K=IC·KD·KH·KW.
- Fold the entire tail (bias + BN affine + 4×4×4 avg-pool) into a single fused kernel: one program per (N, OC_tile, OD2·OH2·OW2 tile), where each program computes the 64 conv-transpose outputs needed for one pooled element, sums them, applies (bias+shift)+scale, and stores. This avoids materializing the (N, OC, 32·OD, ...) intermediate entirely.
- Use channels_last (N, OD, OH, OW, OC) memory layout for both input and weight so the K-dim (IC) and M-dim (OC) reductions coalesce; precompute scale/shift tensors once in `__init__`-time-equivalent forward path (still eval-only).
